_comment: What a config's test suite needs of the machine beyond a C toolchain, CMake and the POSIX
tools (RFC 0038, section 5), read by scripts/corpus-gate.py: `programs` it runs (looked up on
PATH) and `refusesRoot` when the suite does not run as root. Before it builds, --full checks
the selected configs and stops with a setup error (exit status 2) naming what is missing,
never with a test failure; --skip-unavailable leaves those configs out instead.
